reason: I already paste my lecture slides into free ChatGPT and NotebookLM, and in a normal week when I'm not 48 hours out from an exam I'm not going to pre-buy a study pass even if the timer pauses. Free tools feel good enough for $0 until I actually hit an urgent cram.
objection: I'm skeptical this will actually handle my professor's messy slides and specific exam style noticeably better than free ChatGPT and NotebookLM—and the 15-second 'Arena' game framing makes me wonder if it's more gimmick than serious quant prep.
would_change_my_mind: Actually hitting a 48-hour crunch before a tough quant midterm and watching the free 5-question preview nail tricky slide equations that free ChatGPT botched.
